namespace = cwp_indonesia

# Cold War Project: the Indonesian National Revolution (je_cwp_indonesian_revolution)
# Generated by gen_events.py in the decolonization thread's scratchpad; edit freely.

cwp_indonesia.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_indonesia.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indonesia.1.d_net
				trigger = { c:NET ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indonesia.1.d_ids
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indonesia.1.f_net
				trigger = { c:NET ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_indonesia.1.f_ids
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_jungle_expedition"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_revolutionary_flag.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_indonesia.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_indonesia.1.b_net
		trigger = { c:NET ?= ROOT }
		if = { limit = { exists = c:IDS NOT = { c:IDS = ROOT } } change_relations = { country = c:IDS value = 20 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = cwp_indonesia.1.c_net
		trigger = { c:NET ?= ROOT }
		if = { limit = { exists = c:IDS NOT = { c:IDS = ROOT } } change_relations = { country = c:IDS value = -20 } }
		ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_concession years = 2 } }
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_choice_grievance years = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
		}
	}
}
